question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(1)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'across'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"across"** means from one side to the other side of something. (पार)

 
 
• **Example: **She walked across the street to reach the store.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that** **the report stated that within the same time period, there was an 18% increase in measles cases worldwide, totalling nine million illnesses.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct preposition in this context is **'across'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'across'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **For **(के लिए): Used to indicate the purpose of an action or the duration of time.

 
 
• **Example:** He studied for three hours.
 
 
 
• **Through **(के माध्यम से): Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).
 
 
• **Example: **The train passed through the tunnel.
 
 
 
• **Along** (साथ): In a line matching the length or direction of something.
 
 
• **Example:** They walked along the beach.
